products.descSv: The UnniCooking Friteswarmhoudunit is a handy appliance made of stainless steel AISI 304. It is designed to keep your fries warm and crispy. Infrared heating elements are located at the back of the unit to evenly distribute heat, ensuring your fries remain at the right temperature. One of the main advantages of this warming unit is that excess oil can easily drip away through the perforated bottom. This helps to keep the fries lighter and less greasy, resulting in a better taste experience. The warmhoudunit is equipped with a perforated 1/1 GN bottom that is specially shaped for easy scooping

products.descSv: An Induction range hood in the hospitality industry combines extraction with air induction. It draws in fresh air and directs it over cooking zones, efficiently removing fumes, odors, and grease. This enhances air quality, reduces energy consumption, and improves staff comfort, making it ideal for modern, busy kitchens. Key Features of an Induction Range Hood – Air Induction: Creates a controlled airflow by blowing fresh air directly above cooking zones, boosting extraction efficiency. – Efficiency: Performs as well or better than traditional hoods with lower energy consumption. – Grease Filte
